dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Theramore Thunderwoof was surrendered to the care center as a stray and we have no history on her behavior in a home environment. She has not acclimated well to the care center environment, showing significant fear including a tense, tucked body and tail, trembling, flailing during medical examination, and head whipping and panting heavily during her handling assessment. While she does seek proximity to handlers, due to her high levels of fear we recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
dog.name: Theramore Thunderwoof
